Pool ASVs within clusters

Source: R/cluster_fun.R
pool_by_cluster.Rd

Aggregates ASVs belonging to the same cluster and sums their read counts.

Usage

pool_by_cluster(read_count_df, cluster_df)

Arguments

read_count_df

Data frame containing the following columns: asv, sample, replicate (optional), read_count.

cluster_df

Data frame containing the following columns: asv_id, cluster_id.

Value

A data frame with the same structure as read_count_df, where ASVs belonging to the same cluster are pooled into a single entry per sample (and replicate, if applicable).

Details

All ASVs assigned to the same cluster_id are merged, and their read counts are summed for each sample (and replicate, if present).

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
pooled_df <- pool_by_cluster(
  read_count = read_count_df,
  cluster_df = cluster_df
)
} # }
